## Summary

Shenzhen Skyworth Digital Technology is the set-top-box arm of the Shenzhen-based Skyworth Group, which Wikipedia names as its second-biggest subsidiary [1]. Its own site dates the company to a digital TV development team Skyworth Group set up in 1997, records its listing on the Shenzhen A-share market, and carries investor links under stock code 000810 [2]. The IEEE registry lists 62 MA-L blocks to "Shenzhen Skyworth Digital  Technology  CO., Ltd" and 17 to "Skyworth Digital Technology(Shenzhen) Co.,Ltd", both at Block A of the Skyworth Building in Shenzhen, so they are taken here as one company [3].

A MAC in a Skyworth Digital block is most likely a set-top box or a broadband home device supplied by a broadcast or telecom operator: its site lists cable, terrestrial, satellite and network set-top boxes, FTTR and broadband access gear, smart routers, surveillance cameras, smart cockpits and consumer devices [2]. NVD records a remote code execution flaw in the SK-WR6640X Wi-Fi 6 dual-band fiber router, which it attributes to SKYWORTH DIGITAL CO.,LTD [4]. NVD also records an input validation flaw in a Skyworth Router CM5100 that it lists under the vendor Hathway, but does not say which Skyworth entity made it [5].

Silicon and FCC grantee codes are not listed: the FCC ID databases refused requests from this session and no teardown was found, and nothing is filled in from memory. Randomization behaviour is not documented.
